purpose: Test whole-model learning and cost of the existing V1.7 joint recurrence, not claim an organism or isolate latching causality.
phase_boundaries: All actual bridge transitions scored; live state and optimizer never reset.

validation.mode: frozen sidecar; live learner untouched; test split untouched

controls: Same common weights at birth except semantically different alpha bias; identical parameter counts and byte stream. Additional share state 2048 bytes. Candidate content budget=1 is a declared initial choice, not an optimum.
limitations: The recurrences have different feasible content domains and read scales; cannot attribute difference to latching alone.
A/B are source intervals, not externally labeled tasks.
No long-horizon gradient or anti-monopoly guarantee.
5000 updates is budget-limited unless convergence is observed; no strong architecture verdict.

decisions.nonfinite: stop failed arm and diagnose numerical failure before training further
decisions.candidate_worse: keep delta reference; inspect actual memory use, scale and posterior concentration before adding mechanisms
decisions.candidate_better: retain as conditional runtime evidence; causally isolate mechanism before claiming useful latch

engineering.backend: CUDA Graph FP32; projections/MLP vectorized within chunks; exact nonlinear recurrence sequential
engineering.graph_gradient_fix: Preallocate stable gradient buffers before graph capture; 2-update multi-chunk eager equivalence passed in both arms

qualification: 35 GDN tests passed. Lean joint capacity/read invariants previously passed; general stability/release only conditional numerical evidence.
